scholarships.title: SNU Graduate Scholarship for Excellent Foreign Students (GSFS)

existing.description: The SNU Graduate Scholarship for Excellent Foreign Students (GSFS) supports non-Korean applicants who are currently enrolled in or have graduated from one of SNU's listed eligible countries and who apply to a college or school participating in the GSFS Programme. Approximately 20 recipients are selected each semester by the respective colleges and schools on the basis of admission documents. Benefits are full tuition exemption for a maximum of 4 semesters and living expenses of a minimum of 500,000 KRW per month, varying by major. The application is submitted together with the online application for admission to SNU, during the international student admission period each semester.
eligibility: Be a non-Korean applicant currently enrolled or graduated from an eligible country
Have applied and been accepted into Seoul National University
Apply to a college or school designated as participating in the GSFS Program for the relevant semester
Check the current list of eligible countries and participating colleges or schools, which changes every semester
existing.eligibility_summary: Non-Korean applicants who are currently enrolled as students or have graduated from one of the listed eligible countries, who have applied and been accepted into SNU, and who apply to a college or school that is participating in the GSFS Programme for that semester.

Living expenses of a minimum of 500,000 KRW per month, different according to the recipient's major
coverage: Full tuition exemption for a maximum of 4 semesters

Apply for admission to that college or school through SNU's Office of Admissions online application
Check the 'Application for Scholarship' box during the online application
The relevant college or school selects candidates based on the admission documents
existing.selection_notes: Selection is made by the respective Colleges/Schools based on the admission documents. SNU states that the list of eligible countries and participating colleges or schools differs every semester, so applicants must check the current list in the guide sent out each semester by the SNU Office of Global Affairs.
existing.best_fit: Non-Korean applicants from SNU's listed eligible countries applying to a college or school that participates in the GSFS Programme in the semester they intend to enter.
existing.notes: The GSFS and the SNU President Fellowship Program are alternatives rather than combinable: SNU's online application guidance states that if an applicant is selected by both scholarships they must choose only one. The 2027 admissions guide describes the GSFS for applicants who meet the Global Talent Special Track I eligibility and have no prior completion or graduation from a Korean educational institution, with full tuition exemption for up to 2 years and living expenses whose amount and payment period vary by college.
existing.duration: Full tuition exemption for a maximum of 4 semesters
existing.application_period: Every semester, alongside the SNU international graduate admission cycle; approximately 20 recipients.
existing.deadline_display: Application Period: "During admission period for international students every semester". The scholarship application is made at the same time as the online application for admission to SNU's Office of Admissions.
